description: Search the web when the user gave a topic, keywords, or a `site:` query instead of a specific URL. Use this for discovery first; if you already have a direct URL, use smartfetch instead. Can optionally hand off into smartcrawl for same-site exploration. If smart-web returns reproducible incorrect or misleading output, open a GitHub issue on jojo-labs/smart-web with the exact input, arguments, observed output, expected behavior, and version. Skip obvious transient network/auth/rate-limit failures unless smart-web misclassified them.

contextMaxCharacters.description: Maximum text content cap for legacy hosts; output_budget/preferred_budget_chars also project structuredContent.

context_mode.description: Coarse alias/backcompat fallback when no numeric budget control is supplied.

crawl_limit.description: Maximum ranked crawl results to return in the handoff summary

crawl_max_depth.description: Maximum recursive depth for the crawl handoff

crawl_max_pages.description: Maximum number of pages to visit during the crawl handoff

crawl_mode.description: Traversal hint for the smartcrawl handoff

crawl_timeout_ms.description: Per-page timeout for the crawl handoff

crawl_url.description: Optional starting URL for the smartcrawl handoff

headroom_tokens.description: Null means absent. Approximate remaining host context tokens. Uses compact/balanced fallback only; request full explicitly with output_budget or preferred_budget_chars.

numResults.description: Number of search results to return

output_budget.description: Explicit search output projection. Defaults to compact; use full only when the host really wants all result snippets and crawl handoff items.

preferred_budget_chars.description: Null means absent. Preferred host/RPC budget hint. Projects search structuredContent and text to compact/balanced/full before rendering.

query.description: Search-engine style query. Use this when the user gave a topic or keywords rather than a direct URL.

site_crawl.description: After search, hand off into smartcrawl when a crawl_url or site: operator is available

name: smartsearch
title: Smart Search
